run_evaluation: run AVA evaluation given categories, groundtruth, detections, and excluded keys to compute mAP metrics
read_csv_ava: read a CSV file in AVA format and return boxes, labels, and scores dictionaries keyed by image identifier
evaluate_ava: evaluate AVA predictions from numpy arrays against groundtruth and return precision/mAP at 0.5 IOU
get_ava_eval_data: convert prediction scores and boxes into AVA evaluation data format with whitelisted classes
write_results: write AVA detection results to a CSV file in the official AVA evaluation format
